title: Monthly medicine refill
description: A neighbourhood pharmacy in Secunderabad that delivers monthly medicines to regular customers.
main_task:
Call regular customers whose monthly medicines are due.
1. Ask whether they need this month's refill.
2. Ask whether anything changed in the prescription; if it did, ask them to bring the new prescription to the shop.
3. Ask whether they want home delivery or will pick it up.

items.text: Ask whether they need the refill

knowledge.title: Delivery
knowledge.text: Home delivery is free within 5 km of the shop and comes the same day if ordered before 4 pm.

purpose: Remind regular customers of their monthly refill.
goal: The refill is ordered for delivery or pickup.
